claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings, monitoring for weaning readiness as patient is on CPAP/PSV with spontaneous breathing.
Monitor arterial blood gases and oxygen saturation to assess ventilation and oxygenation status.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit given anemia (Hgb 8-10.4 g/dL) and assess need for transfusion.
Monitor platelet count given thrombocytopenia (101-146 K/uL) and assess bleeding risk.
Monitor serum electrolytes (sodium, potassium, chloride, bicarbonate) and renal function (creatinine, BUN).
Monitor blood glucose and continue insulin infusion as ordered for glycemic control.
Continue vasopressor support with phenylephrine drip and monitor hemodynamics (arterial blood pressure, cardiac output, central venous pressure).
Monitor temporary pacemaker settings and rhythm.
Continue antibiotic therapy with vancomycin and cefazolin as ordered, monitoring for infection.
Perform daily assessment of sedation and delirium (Richmond-RAS, CAM-ICU) and pain level.
